title: Scouting Combine provides perfect opportunity for pre-league year physicals

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Scouting Combine provides perfect opportunity for pre-league year physicals
sources.description: While it can be argued (and Simms and I definitely argued about it this morning on PFT Live) that the Raiders and Ravens should have handled various aspects of the failed Maxx Crosby trade differently, the outcome presents an opportunity to make changes aimed at preventing such outcomes in the future.
